cards.ex: We spent the afternoon just roaming around the old city, exploring the narrow streets.
cards.exUz: Biz tushdan keyin eski shaharni daydib, tor ko'chalarni o'rganib yurdik.
cards.uzDef: Bir joyda qolmay, erkin va maqsadсиз yurmoq, sayr qilmoq.

cards.ex: We booked a holiday let in the Cotswolds for our summer vacation.
cards.exUz: Yozgi ta'tilimiz uchun Cotswoldsda dam olish uchun uy ijaraga oldik.
cards.uzDef: Dam olish uchun ijaraga olingan uy yoki kvartira.

cards.ex: The first leg of our journey was a six-hour train ride.
cards.exUz: Sayohatimizning birinchi qismi olti soatlik poyezd sayohati edi.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatning bir qismi, masalan, bir shahardan boshqa shaharga parvoz.

cards.ex: Traffic was moving at a snail's pace due to the accident.
cards.exUz: Yo'l-transport hodisasi tufayli harakat juda sekin edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda sekin, deyarli harakatsiz tezlikda.

cards.ex: She quit her job because she had a thirst for adventure and wanted to travel the world.
cards.exUz: U sarguzashtga chanqoqligi va dunyoni sayohat qilishni xohlagani uchun ishdan bo'shadi.
cards.uzDef: Sarguzasht va yangi tajribalarga bo'lgan kuchli istak.

cards.ex: We spent our days lounging on the sun-drenched beaches of the Caribbean.
cards.exUz: Kunlarimizni Karib dengizining quyoshli plyajlarida dam olish bilan o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Quyosh nurlari bilan to'yingan, issiq va yorqin plyajlar.

cards.ex: The quiet hotel was a welcome respite from the hustle and bustle of the city.
cards.exUz: Tinch mehmonxona shahar shovqinidan keyin hush kelibsiz tanaffus edi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik yoki ishdan keyin qulaylik va dam olish.

cards.ex: They decided to get off the grid and build a cabin in the mountains.
cards.exUz: Ular izdan yo'qolishga qaror qilishdi va tog'larda kulba qurishdi.
cards.uzDef: Zamonaviy texnologiyalar va aloqalardan voz kechib, olisda yashash.

cards.ex: The hotel is in a remote location, far from any town or city.
cards.exUz: Mehmonxona shahardan uzoqda, chet joyda joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Uzoqda, aholidan ajratilgan joy.

cards.ex: I want to go to Italy to get a taste of the Italian lifestyle.
cards.exUz: Men Italiya turmush tarzining ta'mini bilish uchun Italiyaga bormoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsani biroz tajriba qilish, uning nima ekanligini his qilish.

cards.ex: We tried to avoid the touristy areas and explore the less crowded parts of the city.
cards.exUz: Biz turistik hududlardan qochishga va shaharning kamroq gavjum joylarini o'rganishga harakat qildik.
cards.uzDef: Turistlar ko'p tashrif buyuradigan joy, odatda gavjum va qimmat.

cards.ex: We sat in a cafe, soaking up the atmosphere of the bustling marketplace.
cards.exUz: Biz kafeda o'tirib, gavjum bozordagi muhitga singib ketdik.
cards.uzDef: Joyning kayfiyatini, hissini his qilish va zavqlanish.

cards.ex: If you want to experience the real culture, you should go off the beaten path.
cards.exUz: Agar siz haqiqiy madaniyatni his qilishni xohlasangiz, yo'ldan chiqishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Odatda sayyohlar bormaydigan, kamroq mashhur joylarga borish.

cards.ex: This little pub is a local haunt, where everyone knows each other.
cards.exUz: Bu kichik pab - mahalliy maskan, bu yerda hamma bir-birini taniydi.
cards.uzDef: Mahalliy aholi tez-tez tashrif buyuradigan joy, masalan, bar yoki kafe.

cards.ex: She's a real culture vulture, always going to museums and concerts.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy madaniyat muxlisi, doimo muzeylarga va konsertlarga boradi.
cards.uzDef: Madaniyatga, ayniqsa san'at va adabiyotga qiziqadigan odam.

cards.ex: We're looking for a family-friendly resort with a kids' club and a swimming pool.
cards.exUz: Biz bolalar klubi va suzish havzasi bo'lgan oilaviy kurortni qidirmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bolali oilalar uchun mos va qulay bo'lgan kurort.

cards.ex: We decided to take a short getaway to the coast for the weekend.
cards.exUz: Biz dam olish kunlari uchun qirg'oqqa qisqa dam olishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik hayotdan qisqa vaqtga chiqib, boshqa joyga borish.

cards.ex: We need to get a move on if we want to catch the train.
cards.exUz: Agar biz poyezdga ulgurmoqchi bo'lsak, tezlashishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tezroq harakat qilish, shoshilish.

cards.ex: We had a packed itinerary, visiting three cities in just five days.
cards.exUz: Bizda zich rejalashtirilgan dastur bor edi, atigi besh kun ichida uchta shaharga tashrif buyurdik.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p tadbirlar va joylar bilan to'ldirilgan, zich rejalashtirilgan sayohat.

cards.ex: We have a few exciting trips on the horizon for next year.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi yil uchun ufqda bir nechta qiziqarli sayohatlarimiz bor.
cards.uzDef: Yaqin kelajakda bo'ladigan yoki kutiladigan narsa.

cards.ex: We tried some of the local delicacies, including the famous seafood paella.
cards.exUz: Biz mahalliy noz-ne'matlardan, jumladan, mashhur dengiz mahsulotlari paellasidan tatib ko'rdik.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan hududga xos bo'lgan maxsus va mazali taomlar.

cards.ex: We spent the day going sightseeing around the city.
cards.exUz: Biz kunni shahar bo'ylab diqqatga sazovor joylarni ko'rish bilan o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur joylar, tarixiy obidalar va boshqa qiziqarli joylarga tashrif buyurish.

cards.ex: I got this vintage dress at the market for a real steal.
cards.exUz: Men bu eski libosni bozordan chinakam arzon narxga sotib oldim.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi narxda sotib olingan narsa, arzon narx.

cards.ex: She loves to travel to far-flung destinations like Mongolia and Bhutan.
cards.exUz: U Mongoliya va Butan kabi olis maqsadlarga sayohat qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq va nisbatan kam tashrif buyuradigan joylar.

cards.ex: We wanted to get back to nature, so we went camping in the forest.
cards.exUz: Biz tabiatga qaytishni xohladik, shuning uchun o'rmonda lager qurdik.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatda vaqt o'tkazish, shahardan uzoqlashish.

cards.ex: This vacation is a welcome break from the stress of work.
cards.exUz: Bu ta'til ishning stressidan xush kelibsiz tanaffusdir.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik hayotdan hordiq chiqarish, dam olish.

cards.ex: We decided to go to Paris on a whim.
cards.exUz: Biz to'satdan Parijga borishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: To'satdan, oldindan rejalashtirilmagan holda.

cards.ex: She's always had wanderlust and dreams of exploring the world.
cards.exUz: U har doim sayohatga chanqoq bo'lgan va dunyoni o'rganishni orzu qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat qilish va yangi joylarni kashf qilish uchun kuchli istak.

cards.ex: We decided to avoid the well-trodden path and explore the hidden trails.
cards.exUz: Biz yaxshi oyoqlangan yo'ldan qochishga va yashirin yo'llarni o'rganishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilik yuradigan, mashhur yo'l.

cards.ex: We bought souvenirs from local artisans at the market.
cards.exUz: Biz bozorda mahalliy hunarmandlardan sovg'alar sotib oldik.
cards.uzDef: Hududda o'z mahoratini namoyish etadigan odamlar.
